ByAuthorX reads your Zotero library on this computer; it never changes Zotero. In Zotero 7, turn on Settings > Advanced > “Allow other applications on this computer to communicate with Zotero” and keep Zotero open. Items become sources here, and highlights and notes made in Zotero’s PDF reader become notes on those sources, with their page.

ByAuthorX will ask the services you tick below about your references. Only the items listed are sent; your text is never sent. Nothing is requested in the background, and an answer that is not found is reported as “unverified, please check”, never as fake.

ByAuthorX writes a Word copy with Track Changes on and remembers this version. When the copy comes back, Merge reviewed copy… turns the editor’s changes and comments into proposals you accept or reject; your own later edits are kept.

ByAuthorX writes one file for your readers and remembers this version. Send the file however you like (email, a shared folder, a message); nothing is uploaded. When readers send their comments back, choose File > Import reader comments…. Their comments arrive as comments and suggestions for you to accept or reject; your text is never changed for you.
